supported: Plain clipboard text, including multiple nonempty resulting paragraphs, replaces a selection spanning compatible paragraphs within one owned HWPX body textbox. The new paragraphs inherit the starting paragraph shape and style.
refused: Stale clipboard owner or selection, incompatible paragraph shapes or styles, fields and nested controls, IME replacement across paragraphs, HWP5, tabs, blank result paragraphs, and resulting textbox count above 64.
